Draw images

Source: R/draw.R
pdf_draw_image.Rd

Draws an image from pdf_image_new() into the rectangle with its lower left corner at (x, y), width by height points.

Usage

pdf_draw_image(page, image, x, y, width, height)

Arguments

page

A pdf_page from pdf_page_new().

image

A pdf_writer_image.

x, y

The start of the baseline, in points.

width, height

The size on the page, in points.

Value

page, invisibly.

Examples

w <- pdf_new()
img <- pdf_image_new(w, matrix(seq(0, 1, length.out = 16), 4))
page <- pdf_page_new(w)
pdf_draw_image(page, img, 72, 500, 144, 144)
pdf_page_end(page)
bytes <- pdf_save(w)
